x: The litany of recourse against oppression: the Names of severity called on by turn, the plot of the plotter turned back upon his own neck, and the deliverances of Nūḥ, Ibrāhīm, Mūsā and Muḥammad recalled as precedent for the one who calls now.
بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
Bismi Llāhi r-Raḥmāni r-Raḥīm.
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.
اللَّهُمَّ بِسَطْوَةِ جَبَرُوتِ قَهْرِكَ وَبِسُرْعَةِ إِغَاثَةِ نَصْرِكَ وَبِغَيْرَتِكَ لِانْتِهَاكِ حُرُمَاتِكَ وَبِحِمَايَتِكَ لِمَنِ احْتَمَى بِآيَاتِكَ
Allāhumma bi-saṭwati jabarūti qahrika, wa-bi-surʿati ighāthati naṣrika, wa-bi-ghayratika li-ntihāki ḥurumātika, wa-bi-ḥimāyatika li-mani-ḥtamā bi-āyātik.

O Allah, by the might of the majesty of Your dominion, by the swiftness of Your rescuing victory, by Your protective wrath over Your violated sanctities, and by Your protection of whoever seeks refuge in Your verses.
أَسْأَلُكَ يَا اللهُ يَا قَرِيبُ يَا سَمِيعُ يَا مُجِيبُ يَا سَرِيعُ يَا جَبَّارُ يَا مُنْتَقِمُ يَا قَهَّارُ يَا شَدِيدَ الْبَطْشِ
As'aluka yā Allāhu yā Qarību yā Samīʿu yā Mujību yā Sarīʿu yā Jabbāru yā Muntaqimu yā Qahhāru yā Shadīda l-baṭsh.
I ask You, O Allah, O Near, O Hearing, O Responding, O Swift, O Compeller, O Avenger, O Subduer, O Severe in Might.
يَا مَنْ لَا يُعْجِزُهُ قَهْرُ الْجَبَابِرَةِ وَلَا يَعْظُمُ عَلَيْهِ هَلَاكُ الْمُتَمَرِّدَةِ مِنَ الْمُلُوكِ وَالْأَكَاسِرَةِ
Yā man lā yuʿjizuhu qahru l-jabābirah, wa-lā yaʿẓumu ʿalayhi halāku l-mutamarridah mina l-mulūki wa-l-akāsirah.
O You for whom the tyranny of tyrants is no obstacle, and for whom the destruction of rebellious kings and emperors is no burden.
أَنْ تَجْعَلَ كَيْدَ مَنْ كَادَنِي فِي نَحْرِهِ وَمَكْرَ مَنْ مَكَرَ بِي عَائِدًا عَلَيْهِ
An tajʿala kayda man kādanī fī naḥrih, wa-makra man makar bī ʿā'idan ʿalayh.
Make the plotting of whoever plots against me fall upon his own neck, and return the deceit of whoever deceives me back upon him.
وَحُفْرَةَ مَنْ حَفَرَ لِي وَاقِعًا فِيهَا
Wa-ḥufrata man ḥafara lī wāqiʿan fīhā.
And cast whoever digs a pit for me into it.
وَمَنْ نَصَبَ لِي شَبَكَةَ الْخِدَاعِ اجْعَلْهُ يَا سَيِّدِي مُسَاقًا إِلَيْهَا وَمُصَادًا فِيهَا وَأَسِيرًا لَدَيْهَا
Wa-man naṣaba lī shabakata l-khidāʿi jʿalhu yā sayyidī musāqan ilayhā, wa-muṣādan fīhā, wa-asīran ladayhā.
And whoever sets a net of trickery for me - O my Master - cause him to be driven into it, trap him within it, and bind him by it.
اللَّهُمَّ بِحَقِّ كٓهٰيٰعٓصٓ اِكْفِنَا هَمَّ الْعِدَا وَلَقِّهِمُ الرَّدَى وَاجْعَلْهُمْ لِكُلِّ حَبِيبٍ فِدًى وَسَلِّطْ عَلَيْهِمْ عَاجِلَ النِّقْمَةِ فِي الْيَوْمِ وَالْغَدَا
Allāhumma bi-ḥaqqi Kāf Hā Yā ʿAyn Ṣād ikfinā hamma l-ʿid, wa-laqqihimu r-radā, wa-jʿalhum li-kulli ḥabībin fidā, wa-salliṭ ʿalayhim ʿājila n-niqmati fī l-yawmi wa-l-ghad.

O Allah, by the truth of Kāf Hā Yā ʿAyn Ṣād, protect us from the worries of enemies, bring upon them ruin, make them a ransom for every beloved one, and unleash upon them swift vengeance today and tomorrow.
اللَّهُمَّ بَدِّدْ شَمْلَهُمْ اللَّهُمَّ فَرِّقْ جَمْعَهُمْ اللَّهُمَّ قَلِّلْ عَدَدَهُمْ اللَّهُمَّ فُلَّ حَدَّهُمْ
Allāhumma baddid shamlahum, Allāhumma farriq jamʿahum, Allāhumma qallil ʿadadahum, Allāhumma fulla ḥaddahum.
O Allah, scatter their unity, O Allah disperse their gathering, O Allah reduce their numbers, O Allah blunt their edge.
اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلِ الدَّائِرَةَ عَلَيْهِمْ اللَّهُمَّ أَرْسِلِ الْعَذَابَ إِلَيْهِمْ اللَّهُمَّ أَخْرِجْهُمْ عَنْ دَائِرَةِ الْحِلْمِ
Allāhumma jʿali d-dā'irata ʿalayhim, Allāhumma arsili l-ʿadhāba ilayhim, Allāhumma akhrijhum ʿan dā'irata l-ḥilm.
O Allah, turn the tide against them, O Allah send punishment upon them, O Allah remove them from the realm of forbearance.
وَاسْلُبْهُمْ مَدَدَ الْإِمْهَالِ وَغُلَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ وَأَرْجُلَهُمْ وَارْبِطْ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَلَا تُبَلِّغْهُمُ الْآمَالَ
Wa-slubhum madada l-imhāl, wa-ghull aydiyahum wa-arjulahum, wa-rbiṭ ʿalā qulūbihim, wa-lā tuballighhumu l-āmāl.
And strip them of the support of respite, shackle their hands and feet, fasten their hearts, and do not let them reach their hopes.
اللَّهُمَّ مَزِّقْهُمْ كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍ مَزَّقْتَهُ لِأَعْدَائِكَ انْتِصَارًا لِأَنْبِيَائِكَ وَرُسُلِكَ وَلِأَوْلِيَائِكَ وَعِبَادِكَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
Allāhumma mazziqhum kulla mumazzaq, mazzaqtahu li-aʿdā'ika intisāran li-anbiyā'ika wa-rusulik, wa-li-awliyā'ika wa-ʿibādika l-mu'minīn.
O Allah, tear them apart completely, as You tore apart Your enemies in victory for Your prophets and messengers, and for Your saints and believing servants.
اللَّهُمَّ انْتَصِرْ لِي انْتِصَارَكَ لِأَحْبَابِكَ عَلَىٰ أَعْدَائِكَ
Allāhumma-ntaṣir lī-ntiṣāraka li-aḥbābika ʿalā aʿdā'ik.
O Allah, support me with the support You grant Your beloved ones over their enemies.
اللَّهُمَّ لَا تُمَكِّنِ الْأَعْدَاءَ فِيَّ وَلَا تُسَلِّطْهُمْ عَلَيَّ بِذُنُوبِي
Allāhumma lā tumakkini l-aʿdā'a fiyya, wa-lā tusalliṭhum ʿalayya bi-dhunūbī.
O Allah, do not allow enemies to overpower me, nor grant them authority over me because of my sins.
حٰمٓ حٰمٓ حٰمٓ حٰمٓ حٰمٓ حٰمٓ حٰمٓ
Hā Mīm, Hā Mīm, Hā Mīm, Hā Mīm, Hā Mīm, Hā Mīm, Hā Mīm.
Hā Mīm, Hā Mīm, Hā Mīm, Hā Mīm, Hā Mīm, Hā Mīm, Hā Mīm.
حُمَّ الْأَمْرُ وَجَاءَ النَّصْرُ فَعَلَيَّ لَا يُنْصَرُونَ
Ḥumma l-amru wa-jā'a n-naṣr, fa-ʿalayya lā yunṣarūn.
The matter is decreed and victory has arrived; they shall have no victory over me.
حٰمٓ عٓسٓقٓ
Hā Mīm ʿAyn Sīn Qāf.
Ḥā Mīm ʿAyn Sīn Qāf.
حِمَايَتُنَا مِمَّا نَخَافُ
Ḥimāyatunā mimmā nakhāf.
It is our protection against what we fear.
اللَّهُمَّ قِنَا شَرَّ الْأَسْوَاءِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْنَا مَحَلًّا لِلْبَلْوَى
Allāhumma qinā sharra l-aswā', wa-lā tajʿalnā maḥallan li-l-balwā.
O Allah, shield us from evils, and do not make us a site for affliction.
اللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِنَا أَمَلَ الرَّجَاءِ وَفَوْقَ الْأَمَلِ
Allāhumma aʿṭinā amala r-rajāʿi, wa-fawqa l-amal.
O Allah, grant us the hope of expectation and beyond expectation.
يَا هُوْ يَا هُوْ يَا هُوْ
Yā Hū, yā Hū, yā Hū.
O He, O He, O He.
يَا مَنْ بِفَضْلِهِ لِفَضْلِهِ نَسْأَلُكَ
Yā man bi-faḍhlihi li-faḍhlihi nas'aluk.
O You whose grace is sought through His own grace, we ask You.
الْعَجَلَ الْعَجَلَ الْعَجَلَ
Al-ʿajala, l-ʿajala, l-ʿajal.
Hastening, hastening, hastening.
إِلَهِي الْإِجَابَةَ الْإِجَابَةَ
Ilāhī l-ijābata l-ijābah.
My Allah, answer! Answer!
يَا مَنْ أَجَابَ نُوحًا فِي قَوْمِهِ
Yā man ajāba Nūḥan fī qawmih.
O You who answered Nuh among his people.
يَا مَنْ نَصَرَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَىٰ أَعْدَائِهِ
Yā man naṣara Ibrāhīma ʿalā aʿdā'ih.
O You who granted victory to Ibrahim over his enemies.
يَا مَنْ رَدَّ يُوسُفَ عَلَىٰ يَعْقُوبَ
Yā man radda Yūsufa ʿalā Yaʿqūb.
O You who returned Yusuf to Ya'qub.
يَا مَنْ كَشَفَ الضُّرَّ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ
Yā man kashafa ḍ-ḍurra ʿan Ayyūb.
O You who lifted affliction from Ayyub.
يَا مَنْ أَجَابَ دَعْوَةَ زَكَرِيَّا
Yā man ajāba daʿwata Zakariyyā.
O You who answered the call of Zakariyya.
يَا مَنْ قَبِلَ تَسْبِيحَ يُونُسَ بْنِ مَتَّى
Yā man qabila tasbīḥa Yūnusa bni Matta.
O You who accepted the glorification of Yunus son of Matta.
أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَسْرَارِ أَصْحَابِ هَذِهِ الدَّعَوَاتِ الْمُسْتَجَابَاتِ
As'aluka bi-asrāri aṣḥābi hādhihi d-daʿawāti l-mustajabāt.
I ask You by the secrets of the people of these answered prayers.
أَنْ تَتَقَبَّلَ مَا بِهِ دَعَوْنَاكَ وَأَنْ تُعْطِيَنَا مَا سَأَلْنَاكَ
An tataqabbala mā bihi daʿawnāk, wa-an tuʿṭiyanā mā sa'alnāk.
That You accept what we have called upon You with, and grant what we have asked from You.
وَأَنْجِزْ لَنَا وَعْدَكَ الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ لِعِبَادِكَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
Wa-anjiz lanā waʿdaka lladhī waʿadtahu li-ʿibādika l-mu'minīn.
And fulfill for us Your promise which You promised to Your believing servants.
﴿لَّآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنْتَ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
﴾ Lā ilāha illā anta, subḥānaka innī kuntu mina ẓ-ẓālimīn. ﴿
“There is no deity but You; glory be to You! Truly I am among the wrongdoers.” (21:87)
اِنْقَطَعَتْ آمَالُنَا وَعِزَّتُكَ إِلَّا مِنْكَ وَخَابَ رَجَاؤُنَا وَحَقِّكَ إِلَّا فِيكَ
Inqaṭaʿat āmālunā wa-ʿizzatuka illā minka, wa-khāba rajā'unā wa-ḥaqqika illā fīk.
Our hopes have been cut off, by Your might, except from You, and our expectations have failed, by Your truth, except in You.
إِنْ أَبْطَأَتْ غَارَةُ الْأَرْحَامِ وَابْتَعَدَتْ فَأَقْرَبُ الشَّيْءِ مِنَّا غَارَةُ اللهِ
In abṭa'at ghāratu l-arḥāmi wa-btaʿadat, fa-aqrabu sh-shay'i minnā ghāratu Llāh.
If the relief of human aid is slow or distant, then the nearest aid to us is the aid of Allah.
يَا غَارَةَ اللَّهِ جِدِّي السَّيْرَ مُسْرِعَةً فِي حَلِّ عُقْدَتِنَا يَا غَارَةَ اللَّهِ
Yā ghārata Llāhi jiddī s-sayra musriʿatan fī ḥalli ʿuqdatinā, yā ghārata Llāh.
O divine aid of Allah, hasten swiftly in untying our knot - O divine aid of Allah!
عَدَا الْعَادُونَ وَجَارُوا وَرَجَوْنَا اللَّهَ مُجِيرًا
ʿAdā l-ʿādūna wa-jārū, wa-rajawnā Llāha mujīrā.
The aggressors have attacked and oppressed, and we have sought Allah as Protector.
وَكَفَىٰ بِاللَّهِ وَلِيًّا وَكَفَىٰ بِاللَّهِ نَصِيرًا
Wa-kafā bi-Llāhi waliyyā, wa-kafā bi-Llāhi naṣīrā.
And Allah is sufficient as Guardian and sufficient as Helper.
حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
Ḥasbiya Llāhu wa-niʿma l-wakīl.
Allah is enough for me, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.
وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
Wa-lā ḥawla wa-lā quwwata illā bi-Llāhi l-ʿAliyyi l-ʿAẓīm.
There is no power nor might except through Allah, the Most High, the Magnificent.
اِسْتَجِبْ لِي آمِينَ آمِينَ آمِينَ
Istajib lī, āmīn, āmīn, āmīn.
Answer me - Ameen, Ameen, Ameen.
﴿فَقُطِعَ دَابِرُ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا
﴾ Fa-quṭiʿa d-dābiru l-qawmi lladhīna ẓalamū. ﴿
“So the last remnant of the wrongdoing people was cut off.” (6:45)
وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
Wa-l-ḥamdu li-Llāhi Rabbi l-ʿālamīn.
And praise belongs to Allah, Lord of all the worlds.
Ḥizb al-Naṣr — 44 bands. Imām Abū al-Ḥasan al-Shādhilī, d. 656 AH / 1258 CE.
